SELECT A.MOVE_NO, /* 재고이동요청번호 */ A.MOVE_SEQ, /* 재고이동요청순번 */ A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR, /* 출발물류센터 */ A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO, /* 도착물류센터 */ A.REQ_USER_ID, /* 요청자아이디 */ (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NM, /* 요청자아이디 */ TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REQ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REQ_DATE, /* 요청일자 */ A. REQ_TIME, /* 요청시간 */ A.STDCATLG_ID, /* 품목코드 */ A.STDCATLG_ID AS STDCATLG, /* 품목코드 */ (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = B.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.STDCATLG_ID) AS DESCRIPTION, /* 품목명 */ (SELECT SPECIFICATION FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = B.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.STDCATLG_ID) AS SPECIFICATION, /* 규격 */ B.AVAIL_QTY, /* 재고수량 */ A.REQ_QTY, /* 이동요청수량 */ A.MOVE_REMARK /* 비고 */ FROM BNTWMSMOVE A, WMSSTCK B WHERE A.STATUS = '1' AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = B.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND A.STDCATLG_ID = B.STDCATLG_ID AND B.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND (A.CLOSE_DATE IS NULL OR A.CLOSE_DATE = '')
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = #{st_warehouse_code_fr} /* 조회조건(출발물류센터) */
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO = #{st_warehouse_code_to} /* 조회조건(도착물류센터) */
AND A.REQ_USER_ID = #{st_kep_user_id} /* 조회조건(요청자아이디) */
AND A.REQ_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} /* 조회조건(요청일자) */
ORDER BY REQ_DATE

SELECT IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS STDCATLG_ID, IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS STDCATLG, IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, IT.SPECIFICATION, ST.AVAIL_QTY FROM ICOMBYIT IT, WMSSTCK ST WHERE IT.BUYER = ST.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = ST.STDCATLG_ID AND ST.PROCESS_TYPE = '1' AND IT.STATUS <> 'D' AND ST.STATUS <> 'D' AND ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code_fr} AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO IN
#{item}

SELECT A.TEXT1 AS CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.TEXT1) AS TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 A WHERE A.TYPE = 'HUB' AND A.FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.TEXT1 <> #{SEARCH1}

SELECT A.TEXT1 AS CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.TEXT1) AS TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 A WHERE A.TYPE = 'HUB' AND A.FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.TEXT1 <> #{SEARCH1}

/* selectMasterMpSoStockMovemntRequestRegMoveNo */ SELECT 'MO'||TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')||NVL(LPAD(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MOVE_NO, 11, 3)))+1, 3, 0), '001') FROM BNTWMSMOVE WHERE MOVE_NO LIKE 'MO'||TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')||'%'
mapper.update: INSERT INTO BNTWMSMOVE ( MOVE_NO ,MOVE_SEQ ,WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR ,WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO ,STDCATLG_ID ,REQ_QTY ,STATUS ,REQ_USER_ID ,REQ_DATE ,REQ_TIME ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,MOVE_REMARK ) VALUES ( #{st_move_no}, (SELECT NVL(LPAD(MAX(TO_NUMBER(MOVE_SEQ))+1, 6, 0), '000001') FROM BNTWMSMOVE WHERE MOVE_NO = #{st_move_no}), #{st_warehouse_code_fr}, #{st_warehouse_code_to}, #{STDCATLG}, #{REQ_QTY}, '1', #{st_user_id}, #{REQ_DATE}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{MOVE_REMARK} )
